basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old gamer from Austin, Texas, who loves diving into sprawling RPGs like The Witcher series. By day, I'm a software developer, which means I often have a keen interest in tech-related subreddits. Gaming is my escape from the hustle and bustle of coding life, and I enjoy spending my evenings exploring virtual worlds. I'm currently single and enjoy hanging out with my gamer friends on weekends. Although I'm mainly a night owl, I occasionally pop online during lunch breaks for a quick Reddit scroll.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science from the University of Texas and have been working as a software developer for the past five years. My expertise lies in software architecture and game design, primarily self-taught through trial and error and countless hours of tinkering with open-source projects. My passion for gaming also keeps me informed about the latest developments in the gaming industry.
